author: Susie Carmichael
text: Another company told me they couldn’t find my septic tank. These guys came in actually looked and found it within 5-10 mins. Very professional and respectable and quick. I appreciate you guys and you have a returning customer.

author: FTBJAX
text: DO NOT CALL THIS 'COMPANY' THEY ARE A JOKE! They came last week to do a routing septic tank emptying and did not seal the tank when they were done. Open 24 hours?? I don't think so, we called for 3 days before we could get through to someone who happened to be the demented , rude, and lying owner. Instead of admitting her guys made a mistake, she proceeded to tell us we had 1. Drain field damage, when hat didn't work she told us we 2. had a cracked lid. I told her we have neither so she asked me why we called them in the first place. Good question and will never made that mistake again. They caused property damage, money out of pocket to fill their crater left. The worst and hopefully will be out of business soon. AVOID!!

author: Chad Geiger
text: Very poor service called schedule appointment. They told me they could get to it the same day no call no-show. I had to call them the next day told me that it was a $415 rate they come out pump my Septic charged me an additional $50 that was not discussed and just billed it to me anyways so do yourself a favor folks stay far away from this company, the bad reviews speak for itself very unprofessional people.

author: Keeves ?
text: I was a bit skeptical due to the bad reviews, but honestly, they were amazing. The guys came out, drained my septic system, showed me how to clean the filter (that I didn't even know existed), and answered all of my questions about my specific system. I was amazed. If I ever have any problems in the future, this is my first stop!

author: Tara Stewart
text: Made an appointment last weekend for  today at 430 and received a call 20 mins before to let us know they will not be coming. Was told that they sent all their workers home because they were slow and didnt have work for them to do until our scheduled appointment time.... my mind is blown that they didnt even have the decency to call earlier in the day when they first realized they didnt have ebough work and sent them home?!? I honestly didnt believe my husband when he told me this, so I called to see why they weren't coming and the lady seemed very unconcerned and didnt think it was a big deal at all. I rushed around town with a 2 year old to make it in time for this appointment for nothing so yes it is a big deal to me. We also really needed the septic pumped asap and this was the only day we had available. I will not be using them again and do NOT recommend unless you want poor communication and customer service. There is clearly a reason they didnt have enough work to keep their appointments.
